title: API: the part lookup returns inactiveMatch only for a full or normalised match, never for a prefix
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I1 is inactive here; no active part here shares its number. API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com: Network tab, right-click a captured request > Copy as fetch, edit method/URL/body in the Console; header X-Location-ID = the current location's id. Capture the lookup by opening a work order line > Add Part and typing any text; replay GET /api/work-orders/part/request/inventory-parts-as-options-with-remaining-catalogue-parts changing only the search parameter.
custom_steps:
1. GET .../inventory-parts-as-options-with-remaining-catalogue-parts?search=QAPL, then ?search=QAPL-I (prefixes).
  2. GET ...?search=QAPL-I1 (full number).
  3. GET ...?search=qapl-i1 (lower case).
  4. GET ...?search=qapl-i-1, then QAPL.I1, QAPL*I1 and QAPL%20I1 (hyphen, period, asterisk, space variants).
  5. GET ...?search=QAPL-T1 (full number of an active part).
custom_expected:
1. 200 each time; no QAPL-I1 row (no QAPL-I row at all); "inactiveMatch": null.
  2. 200; no QAPL-I1 row; "inactiveMatch":{"partNumber":"QAPL-I1"}.
  3. 200; "inactiveMatch":{"partNumber":"QAPL-I1"} (the stocked number, not the typed one).
  4. 200 each time; "inactiveMatch":{"partNumber":"QAPL-I1"}; no QAPL-I1 row.
  5. 200; the QAPL-T1 row is listed with is_active true and is_tracked true; "inactiveMatch": null.
